story: In the diverse world of birds, the Whiskered Yuhina (Yuhina flavicollis) stands out. This species, part of the Zosteropidae family, is a resident of Subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; evergreen broadleaf forest; and secondary growth. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Whiskered Yuhina is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Whiskered Yuhina and its role in the ecosystem.
